excerpt: Phillip Golub Partisan Ship An album of microtonal jazz played on a Flexichord keyboard proves anall-enveloping experience, for Andrew Taylor-Dawson Partisan Ship by Phillip Golub The word 'immersive' can be overdone or feel forced when applied to artistic endeavours, be it a theatrical performance, an exhibition or indeed an album. Yet, it feels like the natural descriptor for Partisan Ship, the latest offering from LA born, Brooklyn-based pianist, composer and bandleader Phillip Golub.

Visible Cloaks Paradessence Portland, Oregon duo amplify the creaks and cracks between the many different styles in their toolbox Paradessence by Visible Cloaks Paradessence spotlights the innate surrealism of Visible Cloaks shimmering, digital-powered exotica.
